one_liner: Watches the Atlantic fee market and fires only when the trend is real — 5/15 moving-average crossover with a confirmation band, never wave-chasing.
what_it_does: This lamp watches how network fees move over time and only calls a trend when the short-term average crosses the long-term average and stays there. A single spike is never enough — it takes 3 consecutive above-band readings before it fires. Proven by 30 live base-fee observations across real blocks, all recorded below.
